In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a '''battle''' was fought over the planet [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]]. The Valahari forces led by [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]] destroyed the Republic blockade of the planet. The Republic blockade of three Venator-class star- destroyers and their fighter complement would normally be able to defeat a small local fighter wing, but Tofen Vane's piloting skills allowed the confederate forces to destroy the defended V-19s. The remaining Valahari fighters proceeded to use proton torpedoes to obliterate the command bridges of the Republic cruisers, incapacitating them. Soon after Tofen Vane dogfight-ed and eliminate an unnamed Mon Calamari Jedi, while the Valahari fighters mopped up the star destroyers.
